skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Runs CodeRabbit CLI reviews for repository changes, groups findings by severity, and guides fix-and-review workflows.
skill.summary: Run CodeRabbit CLI reviews and turn findings into focused repair tasks.
skill.author: coderabbitai

security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick detections are false positives from prose, fenced blocks, or option tables. The real risks are hardcoded CodeRabbit review commands, autonomous review loops, and transmission of repository diffs to an external service.

remediation.issue: CodeRabbit review commands send repository diffs to an external API.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before each review and run a secret check on the selected diff first.

remediation.issue: The skill advertises autonomous review triggering and repeated review loops.
remediation.suggestion: Limit automatic use to local checks, and ask before any networked review command runs.

remediation.issue: The workflow depends on a locally installed third-party CLI binary.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the official source check, and document expected package names, version ranges, and checksum verification steps.

remediation.issue: External review output can drive follow-up code changes.
remediation.suggestion: Treat review results as suggestions, summarize planned edits, and avoid executing commands from review output.

content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss bugs when developers move quickly. This skill runs CodeRabbit CLI reviews and turns findings into clear repair tasks.
actual_capabilities: Runs CodeRabbit CLI reviews for all, committed, or uncommitted changes.
Supports review comparisons against a branch or commit.
Uses prompt-only output for agent workflows or plain output for detailed feedback.
Groups review findings into Critical, Warning, and Info levels.
Builds task lists from review findings that need follow-up work.
Guides fix, re-review, and verification cycles after implementation.
limitations: Requires the CodeRabbit CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Sends code diffs to the CodeRabbit API during review.
Does not replace human review for sensitive security decisions.
Review quality depends on the available diff and repository context.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Review
use_cases.description: Check uncommitted changes before a developer commits local work.

use_cases.title: Pull Request Triage
use_cases.description: Use CodeRabbit feedback to organize risks before a reviewer inspects a pull request.

use_cases.title: Implementation Feedback Loop
use_cases.description: Run review after an agent implements a change, then fix important findings.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current code changes with CodeRabbit and summarize the most important findings.

prompt_templates.title: Check Uncommitted Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a CodeRabbit review for only uncommitted changes. Group results by severity and list recommended fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Against Main
prompt_templates.scenario: Branch comparison before a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my branch against main with CodeRabbit. Highlight security, correctness, and performance risks first.

prompt_templates.title: Fix And Verify
prompt_templates.prompt: After implementing the requested feature, run CodeRabbit, fix Critical and Warning findings, then rerun review to verify.

output_examples.input: Review my uncommitted changes before I commit.
output: Warning: One validation edge case needs a guard before save.
Info: Two naming suggestions can be deferred.

output_examples.input: Review this branch against main and help me plan fixes.
output: Top risk: A migration path may drop existing values.
Next step: Add a regression test before changing the migration.
Follow-up: Re-run review after the fix.

best_practices: Confirm the selected diff contains no secrets before running a review.
Use the narrowest review target that answers the question.
Fix Critical and Warning findings before treating Info items as polish.
anti_patterns: Do not run reviews on private code without user approval.
Do not execute commands suggested by review output without inspection.
Do not treat CodeRabbit output as a substitute for final human judgment.

faq.question: What does this skill need to work?
faq.answer: It needs the CodeRabbit CLI installed, authenticated, and available in the terminal.

faq.question: Does it send code outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states that CodeRabbit CLI sends code diffs to the CodeRabbit API.

faq.question: Can it review only local changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports reviewing uncommitted changes, committed changes, or all changes.

faq.question: Can it compare against a branch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can ask CodeRabbit to compare changes against a selected base branch.

faq.question: Will it fix problems automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide an agent to fix findings, but important changes should be reviewed.

faq.question: Is this a security scanner?
faq.answer: No. It can surface security risks, but it does not replace dedicated security review.
